lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular white clusters positioned posterior to the gill slits, organized into multiple horizontal rows across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect with the circular spots, creating a rectilinear lattice pattern on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a distinct vertical intensity gradient, with luminance decreasing sharply from the superior to the inferior edge of each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white vertical linear mark located on the dorsal ridge just anterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white spot patterning visible on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
